meta.notes: v1.6: concept-web prerequisite tier — AI-projected, unvalidated, labelled INFERRED PROTOTYPE by the renderer (never in prereqValidated); in-order pairs only. v1.5: SpecificationPoint statement/label and points[].text carry the evidenced presentation normalization (T-SPEC-AUDIT-1 map, parity with the hub's normalizeSpecText — extraction PUA glyphs mapped/stripped; corpus itself stays spine-verbatim). v1.4: hier edges from curriculum truth; prerequisite/related edges from the committed T-C11 prerequisite snapshot where one exists (operator-validated projection + inferred-prototype tier, provenance in meta.prerequisites; reversed cross-product pairs suppressed or demoted to rel per the anchor-evidence pass) — nothing is invented. SpecificationPoint nodes and points carry the canonical applicability object (printed paper/unit/tier/coursework homes, T-KG-16) verbatim from the pinned parse; absent where not derived.

prerequisites.source: AI concept-web startup run (F8 rollout batch ten; T-KG-PRE-12, lane 0500x25). The web is the AI_SUGGESTED, UNVALIDATED concept lattice authored by the F8 lane for this syllabus, every anchor machine-verified against the served spine's point ids (0 unmapped pass law) and exported in-order only by the calibrated law of scripts/kg_f8al_project.py. Bases mirror the operator-validated store vocabulary. prereqValidated stays EMPTY — the renderer labels every shipped pair INFERRED PROTOTYPE; the named gate before any of this is treated as truth remains the SME validation pass.

reversedGovernance.rule: a projected pair that sorts against spec order is suppressed when its in-order sibling is also projected (dual-anchor cross-product), else demoted to the related tier — operator pass 1a0f589530363705, docs/TC11_ANCHOR_EVIDENCE_PASS.md; concept-web pairs (unvalidated) are dropped when reversed, never demoted

prerequisites.projection: concept endpoints resolve through the concept->spec-point anchor map; validated pairs override inferred pairs; reversed cross-product pairs suppressed or demoted to rel; [prerequisite, dependent] direction

points.text: Demonstrate understanding of written texts, and of the words and phrases within them.
Summarise and use material for a specific context.
Develop, analyse and evaluate facts, ideas and opinions.
Demonstrate understanding of how writers achieve their effects and influence readers.
Select appropriate information for specific purposes.
Recognise and respond to linguistic devices, figurative language and imagery.
Express what is thought, felt and imagined.
Organise and convey facts, ideas and opinions effectively.
Demonstrate a varied vocabulary appropriate to the context.
Demonstrate an effective use of sentence structures.
Demonstrate an understanding of audience, purpose and form.
Demonstrate accuracy in spelling, punctuation and grammar.
Discuss what is thought, felt and imagined.
Select and organise facts, ideas and opinions.
Communicate fluently with clarity, focus and purpose for a range of contexts.
Actively engage in a variety of discussions and conversations.
